info.title: Olin Evidence API
info.description: Authenticated evidence enrichment for a controlled Mexican small-business credit-decision pilot. Provider facts remain separate from the recommendation engine. No endpoint in this API moves money.

servers.description: TLS-only pilot deployment; gzip is handled at the reverse proxy

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Exchange a named bootstrap credential for a short-lived signed session.

tags.name: Signals
tags.description: Versioned SME-wide alternative-signal catalogue; indicators are not probabilities of default.

tags.name: Governance
tags.description: Versioned consent and immutable correction workflows.

tags.name: Hosted linking
tags.description: Pre-scoring intake and one-time provider-link bootstrap.

tags.name: Bank callback
tags.description: Consent-bound derived bank metrics; raw transactions are forbidden.

tags.name: Evidence Passport
tags.description: Next-best-evidence guidance; never a loan approval.

tags.name: Operations
tags.description: Authenticated exception projection for the shadow-pilot operator.

tags.name: Outcomes
tags.description: Immutable bank-observed shadow performance and DPD labels.

post.description: Exchanges a named bootstrap credential for a signed session lasting 5-60 minutes. The bootstrap credential is not returned or persisted by the endpoint.

201.description: Short-lived bearer session created.

get.summary: List bank evidence policies for every supported business type
get.description: Returns all SME types, archetype routing, required evidence, operating metrics, stress factors and calibration status.
Separates non-substitutable identity, consent and authority controls from capacity routes and supporting collateral evidence.

post.summary: Find the next acceptable evidence route
post.description: Resolves server-registered evidence IDs bound to the authenticated case tenant, active consent, trusted source attestation, subject, origin and expiry. Returns human-review routing only; callers cannot self-assert verification.

200.description: Route readiness, integrity failures, hard-control gaps and next options.

get.description: Projects open consent-withdrawal tasks, corrections, missing consent, stale intake, partner decision due and payment-state anomalies without mutating their systems of record.

get.summary: Check historical outcome-data sufficiency by business type
get.description: Reports sample, adverse-outcome and label-coverage gates. It does not claim model validation.

200.description: Validation-readiness gates for every supported business type.

post.summary: Create and evaluate a bank-owned shadow case
post.description: Compatibility endpoint. Direct consent assertions are rejected by default in pilot/production; use the verified intake challenge flow. Runs evidence reporting and capacity v2; pharmacy cases remain committee-only.

201.description: Auditable decision-support report with requested, evaluated and proposed amounts.

post.description: Creates a partner-owned shell before consent or provider evidence exists.

201.description: Intake created.

get.description: Returns only the authenticated partner's intake state and never returns a link token.

Cache-Control.description: Sensitive case state is never cached.

post.description: Demo/migration-only route. Rejected by default in pilot/production; use a consent challenge and OTP verification.

201.description: Consent hashed and intake moved to consented.

get.description: Returns the authenticated institution's non-retired assessment, provider-access, and credit-bureau policy snapshots.

post.description: Validates trusted identity and authority bindings, freezes one approved policy snapshot, and dispatches a short-lived one-time code. No consent exists until verification succeeds.

201.description: Challenge dispatched.

503.description: Approved OTP/e-signature provider unavailable or unconfigured.

post.description: Consumes an unexpired one-time code and creates an immutable, hash-verifiable receipt. Five failed attempts lock the challenge.

201.description: Purpose-specific consent receipt created.

post.description: Uses the high-entropy token from the URL fragment to return the exact policy snapshot. The token is sent in the JSON body so it is not placed in query logs or referrer headers.

200.description: Exact, immutable consent policy and challenge status.

post.summary: Accept through the applicant consent link
post.description: Requires both the high-entropy link token and the separately delivered six-digit code. The applicant never receives an institution API credential.

201.description: Immutable consent receipt created.

get.summary: Read and verify a consent receipt
get.description: Returns the authenticated institution's immutable receipt plus current withdrawal status after checking its SHA-256 integrity.

post.description: Revokes active consent and prevents subsequent evidence ingestion for the intake.

201.description: Consent withdrawn and active link cancelled.

post.description: Creates a short-lived, one-time bootstrap token only after assessment consent and active provider-specific access consent are confirmed.

201.description: One-time client token returned; only its hash is stored.

post.description: Exchanges a single-use token for the minimum provider bootstrap context; reuse is rejected.

200.description: Provider adapter bootstrap; token cannot be reused.

post.summary: Convert evidence-ready intake into one immutable case
post.description: Scores an evidence-ready intake once and returns decision support; the bank still makes the official decision.

schema.description: Application fields; bank evidence, consent, owner and shadow mode are forced from the intake.

201.description: Scored case created and linked to intake.

get.summary: List provider readiness without exposing secrets
get.description: Returns configuration and implementation readiness. A configured API key does not imply that the end-customer consent flow is ready.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Reserved field-selection hint for compatible clients; currently ignored.

get.description: Returns all signal definitions, source strategies, metric requirements, applicability and limitations. The catalogue does not make a credit decision.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match across signal id, label, layer, and source strategy.

Cache-Control.description: Authenticated responses are not cached by the current server.

post.summary: Run a live Google Places lookup
post.description: Returns live business, location and review metadata plus the Place ID subset that may be persisted. Google content is supporting evidence, not repayment proof.

200.description: Live place evidence and persistable provider reference.

post.summary: Find a nearby INEGI DENUE establishment
post.description: Matches a declared merchant against the public DENUE registry by name, address and Google-provided coordinates. A match confirms public registry presence, not repayment capacity.

201.description: DENUE lookup result and persistable public fields.

post.summary: Analyze the commercial neighborhood around an SME
post.description: Uses a live INEGI DENUE radius query to derive density, competitors, complementary businesses, radial catchment bands, and partner-isolated aggregate snapshots. Results are contextual evidence, not repayment probability, observed footfall, or drive-time analysis.

201.description: Sector-aware market context, minimized public establishments, snapshot comparison, and attachable signal evidence.

post.summary: Pre-analyze an authorized bank CSV without retaining rows
post.description: Derives cash-flow metrics in memory and returns a content hash. The result is deliberately unverified and ineligible for a production decision until authenticated by a provider or controlled document-review process.

201.description: Derived, unverified metrics and a SHA-256 content reference.

413.description: Request exceeds the 700 KB API envelope.

post.description: Compares the latest 30 complete days with the same prior-year window through Open-Meteo. Weather remains contextual and cannot independently approve or decline an SME.

201.description: Versioned weather signal evidence.

get.description: Returns append-only consent versions visible to the authenticated case owner or authorized reviewer.

post.description: Supersedes the active consent while preserving prior versions for audit.

201.description: Consent recorded; any previous active version is superseded.

post.description: Withdraws a consent version and blocks new consent-dependent bank evidence.

201.description: Consent withdrawn; future bank ingestion is blocked.

get.description: Returns the immutable correction history without rewriting original evidence.

post.description: Records a claimed correction for controlled review while preserving the original value.

201.description: Correction opened; original evidence remains unchanged.

post.description: Records an authorized resolution; accepted changes require creation of a newly versioned score.

201.description: Correction resolved; accepted corrections require a new score.

get.description: Returns consent-bound derived metrics and provenance, never raw transaction rows.

200.description: Verified derived metrics and provenance; never transaction rows.

get.description: Returns immutable DPD and repayment observations visible to the authenticated case owner.

post.description: Derives the DPD bucket server-side and does not mark the case as disbursed. Exact event replays are idempotent.

201.description: Performance event recorded.

post.description: Accepts an exact-body HMAC callback bound to consent and connection. Exact replays are safe; changed payloads under the same event ID are rejected.

parameters.name: X-Olin-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the exact request body, prefixed with sha256=.

201.description: Evidence accepted.

200.description: Exact duplicate event acknowledged without a second write.

BearerAuth.description: Short-lived signed session supplied only over TLS. A named bootstrap credential is accepted only by the session-exchange endpoint when short-lived sessions are required.

ListResponse.description: Collection wrapper used by bounded governance lists.

data.description: Records visible to the authenticated actor.

ShadowCaseRequest.description: Bank-owned shadow case. The pharmacy and bank_features_v2 blocks are mandatory for the pharmacy vertical.

DataAuthorization.description: Bank/counsel-approved historical-data instruction artifact. Olin validates structure and auditability, not legal sufficiency.

OperatingProfile.description: Archetype-specific metrics bounded by the selected business policy.

IntakeCreateRequest.description: Bank-owned case shell created before consent and evidence.

partner_case_reference.description: Unique reference in the bank system.

ConsentChallengeRequest.description: Issue one short-lived challenge for exactly one immutable consent policy.

destination.description: Delivery address; only an HMAC digest is persisted.

ConsentVerifyRequest.description: One-time verification code. The raw code is never persisted.

PublicConsentAccessRequest.description: High-entropy applicant-link token, transported in the body rather than the URL query.

PublicConsentVerifyRequest.description: Applicant proof: active acceptance, possession of the link and the separately delivered code.

LinkSessionRequest.description: Request for a bounded provider-link bootstrap.

ReasonRequest.description: Auditable human reason for a governance action.

CorrectionRequest.description: Claimed correction that does not mutate original evidence.

BankEvidenceCallback.description: Signed consent-bound derived bank metrics; raw transactions are forbidden.

application_id.description: Existing case identifier for direct callbacks.

Provider.description: External evidence-provider readiness, never including credentials.

interactiveLinkingReady.description: Whether the merchant consent widget is operational.

blockingReason.example: Merchant consent widget is not enabled

SignalCatalog.description: Versioned catalogue of the 28 SME-wide evidence signals.

DenueLookupRequest.description: Declared merchant and search circle for a public-registry match.

latitude.description: Search latitude from the live place result.

longitude.description: Search longitude from the live place result.

GeointelligenceRequest.description: Coordinates, radial scope, and transparent SME-sector classification inputs.

targetScian.description: Optional SCIAN prefix selected by the bank or analyst.

targetActivity.description: Optional transparent activity phrase when a SCIAN class is unavailable.

BankCsvRequest.description: CSV content authorized for in-memory pre-analysis.

csvText.description: UTF-8 CSV with fecha/date and monto/amount or credit/debit columns.

BankAnalysisResponse.description: Pre-analysis result that intentionally excludes source transaction rows.

data.description: Derived metrics, content hash and limitations.

WeatherAnalysisRequest.description: Location and optional historical cutoff for weather context.

asOfDate.description: Latest complete historical day, allowing the provider delay.

Error.description: Stable machine code plus an actionable human message.

request_id.description: Trace identifier also returned in X-Request-ID.

Unauthorized.description: Named access token is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated role lacks the required permission.

NotFound.description: No matching provider record was found.

ProviderError.description: External provider is unavailable or not configured.

IdempotencyConflict.description: The event ID was already used with a different payload or binding. Evidence is not overwritten.

error.message: event_id already exists with different content
